test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 07 March 2023)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.**

The athlete’s________ was badly injured due to a fall on the track.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 2, "toe."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Toe"** to any of the five digits at the end of the human foot.

 
 
• Example: He cut his big **toe **on a sharp stone.
 
 
 
• In this sentence, the athlete likely fell and injured his/her toe while running on the track.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are:
 
• **"Toad" **is a type of amphibian, such as a frog.
 
 
• Example: I saw a **toad **hopping across the road.
 
 
 
• **"Tow"** means to pull or drag something behind you.
 
 
• Example: The truck was able to **tow **the broken-down car to the mechanic.
 
 
 
• **"To" **is a preposition that can indicate direction or location.
 
 
• Example: We went to the store **to **buy groceries.
